mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my eaves instead of just repairing them?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your eaves rather than just repairing them when the damage is extensive, widespread, or indicative of a systemic issue. If more than 25-30% of the eaves show signs of significant rot, structural weakness, or repeated water damage in multiple sections, a full replacement often offers a more durable and cost-effective long-term solution. This decision involves a practical tradeoff between the immediate lower cost of a repair versus the greater longevity and comprehensive protection offered by a full replacement.
